parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the instance. The default value is false. Valid values:

- true.

- false.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the region list.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. The value must be GATEWAY.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description:
The tag key.

> - If the All parameter is not specified or is set to false, you must specify TagKey.
